title: Room guidance: emergency hub (card 7), 21 Nov 2026
weak: Occupant-load rates (NBC / VBBL 3.1.17.1) and fixture counts (Table 3.7.2.2.-A) are named by clause, not reproduced: the tool reads the rates to scale fixtures per layout.
Several sizes are the definition's design values or precedent analogies (trust 30-60), not code. They are labelled.

The 50-person refuge is a design ruling figure from Alberta reception-centre guidance (8 Nov), not a code minimum. Larger layouts could hold more; the guidance scales the refuge with spare public floor at the same 3.5 m² a person.
(not yet checked) No outside source yet for the cot store size or the lobby width (drawing choices).
